summary: This note is a short biography of Tony Windis, born January 27, 1933, a former NBA player for the Detroit Pistons. It covers his college career at the University of Wyoming, where he ranks second all time in the school's career scoring average at 21.2 ppg. It also gives his draft position in the 1959 NBA Draft and his statistics in nine games for Detroit during the 1959-60 season.
one_line: Tony Windis is a former NBA player for the Detroit Pistons who starred at the University of Wyoming and was drafted in 1959.
key_facts: Tony Windis was born on January 27, 1933.
Tony Windis is a former NBA basketball player for the Detroit Pistons.
Tony Windis played college basketball at the University of Wyoming.
Tony Windis ranks 2nd all time in the University of Wyoming's career scoring average with 21.2 ppg.
Tony Windis was drafted with the second pick in the fifth round of the 1959 NBA Draft.
Tony Windis appeared in nine games for the Detroit Pistons in the 1959-60 NBA season.
In the 1959-60 NBA season, Tony Windis averaged 4.0 points per game for the Detroit Pistons.
In the 1959-60 NBA season, Tony Windis averaged 5.2 rebounds per game for the Detroit Pistons.
In the 1959-60 NBA season, Tony Windis averaged 3.6 assists per game for the Detroit Pistons.
